evidence.description: Already redacted (knowledge/redaction.py) before this object is ever constructed.

errorCode.description: A stable, named error code, or null when status is ok.

tool.description: The tool that made this result (policy/tool_matrix.py name). Optional for results made before it existed.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical JSON of every other field, under a local key (orchestrator/result_signing.py). Present when a key is configured.
